basics.name: Omer Burak Demirel
basics.label: Ph.D.
basics.summary: MRI Clinical Scientist at Philips Healthcare supporting Mayo Clinic, with expertise in MRI reconstruction, deep learning, and translation of advanced imaging methods into clinical practice.

work.name: Philips Healthcare
work.summary: Supporting clinical research and product development in cardiac and interventional MRI in collaboration with Mayo Clinic.
highlights: Develop advanced algorithms for MRI reconstruction and post-processing
Collaborate with Mayo Clinic and Philips R&D teams
Optimize MRI workflows and imaging sequences
Translate research algorithms into clinical deployment

work.name: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Harvard Medical School
highlights: Developed deep learning algorithms for accelerated cine and 3D LGE MRI
Deployed inline reconstruction methods in clinical workflows

work.name: University of Minnesota
highlights: Designed self-supervised deep learning methods for cardiac MRI and fMRI
Contributed to Human Connectome Project reconstruction pipelines

awards.title: Gerald M. Pohost Award
awards.summary: Awarded for most impactful paper: 'Late gadolinium enhancement cardiovascular magnetic resonance with generative artificial intelligence.'

awards.title: Best Poster Award
awards.summary: For PRIME framework enabling deployment of custom MRI reconstruction algorithms on scanner.

awards.title: American Heart Association Predoctoral Fellowship
awards.summary: Top-ranked fellowship (0.12%) for work on high-resolution cardiac perfusion MRI.
